name: ai-jue-adapter-openclaw
description: Synthetic, test-only Adapter for a fictional OpenClaw-shaped Agent (JUE-302). Built off the real OpenClaw 2026.5.5 native shape (workspace skills, workspace hooks, global-only MCP via openclaw.json) but declares itself honestly with `degraded` capabilities where the real surface has no first-class Canonical equivalent (no separate rules directory, no per-workspace MCP, no `commands` directory, no separate agents directory).
